findings.claim: The observed selection window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.49] with 50 recorded score nodes at 0.01 spacing; the learning window is [0.0, 0.5] and curve support is [0.0, 0.49].

For landmark_00_local_dx, the observed-node linear trend is non-monotone: the early-window rate is negative (first_rate_z = -17.49) and the late-window rate is positive (last_rate_z = +8.11), with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches.

The whole-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx is near zero (whole_window_z = -0.18) and the quadratic polynomial fit is not accepted (polynomial_accepted = false, relative_node_RMSE = 0.78), so a single stationary target or a monotone drift is not supported for this coordinate over the observed window.

hypotheses.direction: non-monotone; early negative rate, late positive rate
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign change in the node-to-node rate, or a whole-window trend consistent with a single stationary value.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx (predicted endpoint world-A local x-displacement of landmark 00)
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score-node window [0.0, 0.49]
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_local_dx shows a time-dependent contrast over the observed selection window: it decreases through the early-to-middle nodes and increases toward the late nodes, rather than holding a fixed value.

hypotheses.direction: near-zero whole-window mean; polynomial not accepted
hypotheses.falsifier: An accepted polynomial fit with a stable non-zero whole-window mean over the same support.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx whole-window mean and polynomial acceptance
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx contrast is not a reliable absolute coordinate target: the whole-window mean is near zero and the accepted-fit test fails, so any reward built on it should be framed as a changing contrast rather than a fixed target value.

limitations: Only one coordinate curve (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; the remaining 199 curve features were not inspected, so no cross-coordinate comparison is claimed.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves were used.
The observed curve is a predicted-endpoint world-A feature, not a measured physical energy or affinity; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
Selection preference is association only; no descendant survival or decoded final-affinity outcome is available in this input, so no benefit claim is made.
The 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 batches indicate batch-level heterogeneity that limits the strength of the trend statement.
